catalog.title: Seiko Sport Diver
catalog.note: Not a catalogue but the dealer bulletin 'SEIKOセールス' No.132 (June 1969, '69 SEIKO 夏の販売促進のお知らせ), Five Sports campaign pages (printed pp.12–16): 61-5D 25石, 61-5 21石/23石 and 61SP Speed-Timer models, each captioned セイコーファイブスポーツ + family code, jewels (石), model number, features and the SS・WP price in yen; 近日発売 = coming soon. Despite the file name there is no dedicated diver. Codes follow the 1969 JDM catalogues (61-5D 6106, 61-5 21石 6119, 61SP 6139); the 23-jewel 61-5 models are new in this bulletin and their caliber is left blank. The scan is soft: blurred captions were cross-checked against the same model numbers in the 1969 JDM catalogues and marked medium/low. The two cover watches have no caption and are not recorded. Dial colours are read from the photos.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops.
